_description: Context Graph Feature Toggle Schema. Defines the sub-toggles and their behavior for incremental rollout of context graph intelligence.

helper_functions.is_context_graph_enabled(customer_id): Returns True only when BOTH global AND customer toggles are ON
helper_functions.get_context_graph_config(customer_id): Returns full sub-toggle dict with defaults

story_arcs.description: Generate and consume story arc manifests with causal chains instead of flat journey patterns
impacts: demo manifests — use CAST + PLOT_POINTS + CAUSAL_CHAINS format

signal_edges.description: Build causal and correlation edges between signals (CAUSED_BY, CORRELATES_WITH, PRECEDED_BY)
impacts: signal_analyst_agent — traverses edges for causal context
data_ingestion_api — creates edges from real-time events

stakeholder_tracking.description: Track stakeholders as graph nodes with engagement events, silence detection, influence scoring
impacts: signal_analyst_agent — considers stakeholder engagement in analysis

decision_lifecycle.description: Track decisions through lifecycle: recommended → accepted/rejected/expired → executed → outcome
impacts: playbook system — creates decision nodes linked to playbook executions
outcome tracking — links decisions to outcomes for feedback loops

outcome_economics.description: ROI scoring per decision with cost, expected revenue impact, confidence, evidence chain
impacts: executive dashboard — CRO/CFO revenue intelligence views

industry_benchmarks.description: External context nodes enabling 'your GPU util is 11pts below industry median' comparisons
impacts: signal_analyst_agent — includes benchmark context in analysis

guard_pattern.description: How every consumer should check the toggle before using context graph features

rollout_order.reason: Foundation — causal edges are the graph
Narrative manifests depend on edges + stakeholders
Requires edges + stakeholders to generate evidence
External context, independent but last priority
